environment.description: AWS Lambda function with Function URL configured with AuthType=NONE. The function is deployed in a VPC with connectivity to an RDS PostgreSQL instance. The function URL is publicly accessible at https://abc123.lambda-url.us-east-1.on.aws/. No WAF, no resource policy restrictions, no VPC endpoint policies limiting access. The DB_USER 'migration_admin' has DDL privileges and INSERT/UPDATE on all tenant schemas.

config.vpc_config: private subnets with NAT, RDS in same VPC
